name: 56-vitest-limit-concurrency-async-run
title: Simplify limitConcurrency run() with async/await
body: The run helper special-cased native promises with `instanceof Promise`, so PromiseLike results from other libraries were treated as plain values. This turns run into an async function with try/finally, which handles sync values, sync throws and any thenable uniformly.

bugs.why: The promise from func is returned without await, so the finally block releases the slot immediately instead of after the task settles, letting unlimited tasks run concurrently.
